text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should observe the laws and decrees of China as well as the rules and regulations of the university, while respecting the customs and traditions of the Chinese people. Additionally, they should demonstrate good moral character, have no criminal record, and be in good health, enabling them to study and live independently in China. 2. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, between the ages of 18 to 40 (Date of Birth is after August 31, 1985). Applicants under the age of 18 as of September 1, 2025, must have a guardian in China. 3. With both or one of the parents being Chinese citizens and residing outside China, the applicant who acquired a foreign nationality at birth shall hold a valid foreign nationality certificate for at least 4 years before applying. In addition, the applicant’s record of at least 2 years of actual residence abroad during the last 4 years must be provided (from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025). The actual residence of more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year subject to the date on the entry and exit stamp. For residents of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan who immigrated to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please also follow the requirements above. 4. Applicants should have a certificate equivalent to a Chinese high school graduation certificate or above. 5. Applicant’s Chinese proficiency must meet the requirements of the majors applied for. For those applying for the “Chinese as a Second Language” major and “Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages” major, a minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 4 is required; for other majors, a minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 5 is required. Applicants from institutions that have signed a cooperative agreement with BNU are required to meet the language proficiency requirements set forth in the agreement.
